summary: Star Bulk Carriers Corp. filed a Form 6-K on September 15, 2026, attaching two press releases: the results of a public offering in Greece of new common shares and the commencement of trading of those New Shares. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report on an ordinary shelf takedown, incorporated by reference into existing Registration Statements on Form F-3 and S-8. No special-situation terms such as price per share, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date are stated. This is a capital-raising activity, not a special situation, and no deal-risk arbitrage angle applies.
